note:
Households from the 1891 census, transcribed by A. Hagues, whose address this record cannot place. Deliberately NOT named people_*.json, so the importer never reads it. They fall into two quite different kinds, and the distinction matters.

FIRST: numbered addresses on streets the record holds, at numbers it does not. Cavendish Road 1 to 19 against a record that begins at 23 Cavendish Road East; Pelham Crescent 2, 4 and 6 against a record whose Pelham Crescent starts at 1 and 3 and then jumps; Clumber Road numbered 3 to 32 against a record that knows Clumber Road only by house names. These look like real Park houses the record is missing rather than places outside it, and each is worth adding as a property once somebody confirms the house still stands.

SECOND: house names with no number, which is the harder kind. Some may be houses the record holds under another name.

Nothing here is imported until an address is settled.
source: 1891 census — transcribed by A. Hagues from the enumerators' pages

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Richard Fitzhugh
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: The Fitzhughs, whom the record already holds at 3 Cavendish Crescent South (#78) for 1891 — so this may simply be the enumerator's name for that street.

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Jameson McCraith
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: The McCraiths, whom the record holds at 3 South Road (#302) for 1891. Same household, same four servants, same three-month-old Kenneth York. One of the two addresses is wrong.

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: William Godfrey Gregory
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: The Gregorys, whom the record holds at Clumber House, PARK DRIVE (#239) for 1891. Two pages now head this household Clumber Road. The house description mentions access from Cavendish Crescent South, so it plainly has more than one frontage.

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Benjamin Dowson
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: The Dowsons, whom the record holds at Felixstowe, Clumber Road West (#394).

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Frederic Wadsworth
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: The Wadsworths, whom the record holds at Newlands, Lenton Avenue for 1901.

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Walter Sampson
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: The Sampsons, whom the record holds at 29 Lenton Avenue later.

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Henry Crewdson
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: Crewdson, whom the record holds at 25 Lenton Avenue for 1901 and 1911.

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Sarah Guildford
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: The Guilfords, whom the record holds at 23 Lenton Avenue. Spelt Guildford on this page.

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Alfred Harriman Clarke
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: Clarke, whom the record holds at 9 Western Terrace for 1911.

numbered_but_outside_the_record.head: Charles Henry Clarke
numbered_but_outside_the_record.note: The Clarkes, whom the record holds at 10 Western Terrace for 1901. Catherine Clarke is returned as a lace manufacturer in her own right.

house_names_with_no_number.name: Burton House, Maxtoke Road
house_names_with_no_number.head: Elizabeth Sarah Waters
house_names_with_no_number.note: The record has a Burton House at Newcastle Circus (#205). Either the same house addressed differently, or a second of the name.

house_names_with_no_number.name: Maxtoke Road (unnamed)
house_names_with_no_number.head: Adolph Keene
house_names_with_no_number.note: German householder living on his own means, Belgian wife. The record holds only 6 Maxtoke Road (Stowe House, #202).

house_names_with_no_number.name: Linde House, South Road
house_names_with_no_number.head: Julius Meyer
house_names_with_no_number.note: German commission merchant with a German governess. Reading of the house name uncertain — may be Lindo.

house_names_with_no_number.name: Parkmount, Park Drive
house_names_with_no_number.head: Otto Homberger
house_names_with_no_number.note: Homberger, whom the record holds at Linden House, Clumber Road West (#605, #606) for 1911.

house_names_with_no_number.name: Clumber Lodge, Cavendish Road
house_names_with_no_number.head: George Henry Buttrum
house_names_with_no_number.note: IMPORTANT: Clumber Lodge is one of the two 1901 households still sitting unfiled from the Lenton Avenue import. This 1891 page puts a Clumber Lodge on Cavendish Road, which may settle where it is.

house_names_with_no_number.name: Weston Lodge, Lenton Road
house_names_with_no_number.head: Charles Ingle Yorke
house_names_with_no_number.note: The record has Weston Lodge on Hardwick Road (#126).

house_names_with_no_number.name: Pelham Cottages, Pelham Crescent
house_names_with_no_number.head: several households
house_names_with_no_number.note: At least four households: the Pitts, Sarah Warriner, Elizabeth Baker a laundress, and Henry Alfred Pitts a coachman. The service cottages of the crescent, and the record holds no such address.

house_names_with_no_number.name: Thorn Lea, Pelham Crescent
house_names_with_no_number.head: George Elmsley Coke
house_names_with_no_number.note: Returned twice — once with the Cokes, once with his wife's mother and sister, the Humbles. 10 Pelham Crescent (#279) may be it.

house_names_with_no_number.name: Lincoln Villa, 11 Pelham Crescent
house_names_with_no_number.head: Joseph Bright
house_names_with_no_number.note: THE SHARPEST CONFLICT. The record holds Lincoln Villa as 11 WESTERN TERRACE (#350), and I filed the Brights there for 1901 this morning off a page that also called the house Lincoln Villa. Either the family moved and carried the name, or one of the two transcriptions has the street wrong.
